notes.title: Minor Patch 4
notes.content:
[h3]Features/QOL[/h3]
- MAJOR: If an enemy is in combat at the end of a day they will not deal damage to the Player at the end of the day. Only dormant enemies deal damage to the Player at the end of days now.
- Removed the softlock at the start of the game where if you were to craft a wire instead of the locator you wouldn't be able to craft a locator

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
- Removed the ability to stack chests
- Removed bug in blueprint selection popup ui where you can select multiple blueprints to unlock if you were quick enough to select more than one
- Fixed the bug of bots and the player going all over the board when attacking
- Fixed achievement "Professional Professor" to be given when ALL blueprints are unlocked

notes.title: Minor Patch 3
notes.content:
- Adjusted enemy drop chances to be more forgiving
- Fixed a bug where if you take an unpowered bot and place it in combat the bot will essentially be powered 
- Fixed the major saving bug where blueprints were not getting reset on a game run being reset
- Added and updated some card descriptions
- Whole save system refactored (This is more dev related but pretty important for continued work on the game)

notes.title: Minor Patch 2
notes.content:
- Can no longer move camera while hovering over ui element
- Added ability to move camera with WASD keys
- Small optimiazations

notes.title: Minor Patch 1
notes.content:
- All achievements should now be unlockable
- Removed the option to change game speed via in game button (Please use shift and space for now) this is causing a major issue with the game time I still need to fix it.
- When you restart a run EVERYTHING is now reset correctly
- Changed feedback keybind to f2

- addressed major issues with card stacking and movement, should work fine for all computers now
- adjusted blueprint requirements 
- adjusted cell drop rates to be more forgiving

- addressed major issues with card stacking and movement, should work fine for all computers now
- adjusted advanced bots stats
- adjusted mother flys stats
- researched cards and research progression now save

- addressed major issues with card stacking and movement.
- adjusted forest to drop ruin cards more often
- added an option to toggle between full screen and windowed
- adjusted ruins to drop more cell cards
- pretty sure SoftLock was removed. The one that didn't allow you to interact with anything on the board. If this is still persistent, please just exit and reload your save until I get it fixed.
- settings now autosave
